LanguageData.TMM.Farming.ExpandHelp: Mark an extension next to the greenhouse. The resulting footprint is rectangular, up to 64×64. New perimeter and supports require normal construction and materials. After they are complete, old interior panels are designated for deconstruction and the growing area expands automatically.
LanguageData.TMM.Farming.ExpansionInvalid: An adjacent clear area without another zone or roof is required; maximum footprint is 64×64. Finish the previous expansion first.
LanguageData.TMM.Farming.CancelExpansionHelp: Cancel the pending plan. Frame materials are returned through normal cancellation; already completed structures remain.
